title: The empty route after 56.34 seconds
body: The location copy preserves 56.34 seconds beside an empty route line. The key tag says RETURNED, but the exit mark is missing. A child has drawn a house on the margin.
rival_reading: A local work route could record a lap time beside an incomplete key return; an empty line does not prove that containment failed.
gloss: A recorded interval remains beside an empty route and a returned key.

title: The field note before 1 minute, 14.55 seconds
body: The map annotation keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds. The notebook has a field-water line with no source; the bottle is marked after application. A thumbprint covers the route entry.
rival_reading: Emergency crews could record field water after a diversion and leave a route entry incomplete; the missing source does not establish an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A field-water note without a source sits beside a recorded interval and an unfinished route entry.

title: Acknowledgment after the restriction
body: The route acknowledgment is entered after the road restriction. The copy still preserves 56.34 seconds. The recipient field is blank, and a pencil has drawn a box around the return instruction.
rival_reading: A route acknowledgment could be ordinary scheduling after access changed; a blank recipient field does not prove a failed containment order.
gloss: A dispatch acknowledgment follows a restriction while its recipient remains unnamed.

title: The field measure signed alone
body: The receipt’s field measure is dated before the route round was closed. The map beside it keeps 1 minute, 14.55 seconds. Only the container line is signed; the origin box is empty.
rival_reading: The timing could be ordinary field planning while the road restriction came later; an unsigned origin box does not identify the cause.
gloss: A dated field measure and copied interval remain with a signed container line but no origin.
